title: Easy Crumbly Turkish Lamb Cig Kofte
description: A weeknight Turkish dish featuring lamb, mixed peel, and spices, reduced to a jammy and crumbly texture, this recipe is low-calorie-friendly and easy to make, formed into cig kofte for a delicious meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, chopped onion, mixed peel, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and mix well with your hands until just combined.
Divide the mixture into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a small cylinder, about 1 inch in diameter and 3 inches long.
Place the cig kofte on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each kofte.
Drizzle the olive oil over the kofte and gently roll them to coat evenly.
Bake the kofte in the preheated oven for 18 minutes, or until they are cooked through and lightly browned on the outside.
Remove the kofte from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kofte hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
